results.value: select "users"."id", "contacts"."id", "contact_types"."id" from "users" left join ("contacts" inner join "contact_types" on "contacts"."contact_type_id" = "contact_types"."id") on "users"."id" = "contacts"."id" and exists (select * from "countries" inner join "planets" on "countries"."planet_id" = "planet"."id" and "planet"."is_settled" = ? where "contacts"."country" = "countries"."country" and "planet"."population" >= ?)
